HPF_cutoff_Hz.name: HPF_cutoff_Hz
HPF_cutoff_Hz.recipe: let((g p ref threshold) g=dB20(getData("VOUT_SENSE:p" ?result "ac-ac")) p=clip(g 2000 20000) ref=value(g sqrt(2000*20000)) threshold=ref-20*log10(sqrt(2)) if(((ymax(p)-ymin(p))<=1) && (value(g 1)<threshold) then cross(clip(g 1 2000) threshold 1 "rising") else nil))
HPF_cutoff_Hz.aggregate: worst normalized bound margin across every configured corner
HPF_cutoff_Hz.note: First rising half-power crossing relative to measured passband gain. Provisional passband qualification window: 2-20 kHz (10-100 times the 200 Hz target), at most 1 dB peak-to-peak variation; reference gain at the geometric centre, 6.3246 kHz. The low-frequency gain must be below the half-power level. Window and flatness are measurement assumptions, not paper specifications; a failed qualification produces no fc. Target band: 180-220 Hz.
